latin_text: haec illa pax quam facit Deus in excelsis suis, quam angeli in terram descendentes annuntiarunt hominibus bonae voluntatis, ut per eam ipsi homines ascendentes in caelum angeli fierent.
english_translation: that peace which God makes in His heavens, which the angels who came down to earth announced to men of good will so that these men would, ascending to heaven, be transformed by it into angels.
exegesis: Angels function as soteriological mediators: they descend to announce divine peace, enabling humans of good will to ascend and become angels themselves. The Incarnation (Lucean nativity passage) becomes the paradigm of angelic-human mediation and mutual transformation.
notes: Angelology and soteriology converge: angels descend to announce peace, enabling humans to ascend and become angels. The angels function as mediators between the transcendent and immanent realms.
